description: CarboLifeCalc is a desktop calculator for embodied carbon in building designs. It extracts material quantities from Autodesk Revit or Rhino Grasshopper and maps them to environmental product declarations or user-provided carbon databases. Outputs include project charts, heatmaps and results in CSV or JSON formats, including named LCA exchange formats. The spatial boundary is the selected building or design, and there is no fixed time series. Source is free under MIT terms, with compiled releases and a wiki. The README says it can run standalone or inside Revit Viewer, so a full Revit licence is not required for extraction through that route. A limitation is that results depend on the selected emissions factors and the material mapping; this is an embodied-impact calculation, not operational building-energy simulation. The repository distinguishes Revit 2023-2024 and Revit 2025-and-later builds. It supports comparing structural and material choices for built infrastructure. No Revit or Grasshopper design was opened. It complements building energy models such as EnergyPlus (model-energyplus), which simulate operations, not material emissions.
name: CarboLifeCalc building embodied-carbon calculator
